data.name: patchNotesInfo.Text
data.value:
[MANUAL GAME QUEST RUNNER (LOWEST RISK - SAFEST)] - Zero Discord tokens, zero memory patching, and zero client mods. - Pulls Discord's official detectable games list and lets you choose the target Win32 executable when multiple game binaries exist. - Stages StubHost.exe to the exact registered path so Discord detects a real Windows game binary and generates a proper executable_fingerprint. - Supports custom quest durations (1 to 120 min) plus a randomized overshoot tail (0 to 15 min) so sessions never close on the exact quest timer. - Automatically kills and deletes the staged dummy executable when a session completes or is stopped.
[OPTIONAL CDP MODE (CHROME DEVTOOLS PROTOCOL)] - Auto-CDP is OFF by default (safe mode). Nothing runs 127.0.0.1:9222 on startup unless you enable Auto-CDP or click Connect CDP. - No shortcut editing required: Click the Relaunch Discord button to temporarily start Discord with local debugging (127.0.0.1:9222) for that session, then click Connect CDP. - Temporary by design: You do not need to add launch arguments to your Discord shortcut. Quitting and reopening Discord normally closes the debugging port automatically so it is never left permanently exposed. - Not required for Manual Game Runner: You can run game quests without relaunching Discord or connecting to CDP. - Syncs live eligible quests and your current Orb balance, and automatically halts all quests if questAccessSuspendedUntil or questEnrollmentBlockedUntil is detected. - Video quests pace progress ticks through Discord's own Chromium stack. Defaults to 7.0-9.5s to match Discord's native player heartbeat, with customizable min/max interval sliders, an Auto-Enroll toggle, and reset. - Preferences (Auto-CDP, video pacing, and auto-enroll) are saved locally in %LocalAppData%\OrbKit\settings.json.
[EXTERNAL CDP PATCH SCRIPTS AND VALIDATION] - Supports hot-swapping CDP logic via Scripts\cdp_patch.js in the application folder so broken Discord store or API paths can be patched without waiting for a new executable build. - Use Import .js, Export, Folder, and Reset on the Video Quests tab to manage custom scripts. - Layer 1 (Static Security Scan): Enforces a 128 KB size limit, required patch methods, and balanced syntax, while blocking external URLs, fetch/XHR/WebSockets, token or storage access, eval/Function, obfuscation, OAuth/billing paths, and DiscordNative IPC. - Layer 2 (Zero-Execution Check): When CDP is connected, Discord's engine compiles imported scripts without running them to catch syntax errors before activation. - Layer 3 (Integrity and Fallback): Displays the patch script's version and full SHA-256 hash before import. Any manually dropped Scripts\cdp_patch.js that fails validation is rejected automatically with safe fallbacks to the built-in patch.
[INTENTIONALLY OMITTED] - Achievement OAuth forgery, console/activity spoofing (Xbox, PlayStation, Activity), and auto-claiming rewards are disabled to avoid Account Standing strikes and captcha loops.
